actual_requirement: Worker streams hashes of all original source paths after release and old CPU gate, before cuda allocator/device operations. Compare loaded Torch library map paths with these source origins; no DSO copy into output.
source_claim_scope: Wheel RECORD names/SHA/size are an externally reviewable expectation, not a claim actual DSO bytes have already been verified.
loaded_origin_scope: Every mapped path in exact Torch lib namespace and every duplicate pinned Torch library basename must match an explicit wheel RECORD DSO origin, including .so.N. Exact Torch._C module path must be pinned and mapped. Other packages may have distinct _C DSOs; these are not Torch solely by basename. Eight original required loaded paths remain unchanged.
